HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

我们的福利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

  • 假期福利

除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。

  • 全面的福利保险计划

包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。

  • 员工体检

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

  • 弹性福利

当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

  • 心理健康咨询

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

  • PSQP专业进修计划

专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

    • At least 8 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
    • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
    • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
    • Strong focus on client servicing
    • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
    • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID:50271

Principal Responsibilities

  • Engage with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users, and relevant subject matter experts to understand, clarify, and prioritise business requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into deliverable solution approaches, functional requirements, and high-level design documentation.
  • Contribute to the technical and logical design of key components, producing required design artefacts and interface specifications.
  • Communicate functional solutions to the development team and provide ongoing support as needed.
  • Work closely with the production support team to ensure requirements and delivered solutions are well understood and readily supportable.
  • Promote solution architecture principles, best-practice techniques, standards, and tools.
  • Provide recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions.
  • Document and share best-practice knowledge for new solutions.
  • Advocate for process improvements and support the development of solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) and technical validation activities to assess feasibility and risks, and recommend suitable approaches.
  • Participate in design reviews and solution/code walkthroughs, providing constructive feedback and driving issues to closure.
  • Manage design activities within own scope during agile iterations, delivering in line with product and delivery timelines.
  • Identify and document key technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt, and drive alignment with stakeholders on remediation plans.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise, Platform, and other architecture roles to align direction and continuously improve existing solutions within agreed frameworks.
  • Support delivery coordination activities as required (e.g., requirements clarification, plan alignment, and cross-team communication).

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working as a Solution Architect within a large organisation.
  • Strong logical thinking with the ability to abstract architectural patterns from technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to articulate, present, and drive approval of solutions at the appropriate level for both IT and business audiences.
  • Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub).
  • Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL/data integration.
  • Operating systems and scripting: Linux, shell scripting, PowerShell.
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, Azure, AWS).
  • Experience with big data platforms (BigQuery, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks).
  • Experience in data modelling, with a solid understanding of data model design.
  • Proven analytical skills with the ability to challenge designs and decisions.
  • Experience managing and resolving complex issues using strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to quickly get up to speed with the current data landscape 5and apply analysis and data skills to new contexts and approaches.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong virtual communication (conference calls, video conferencing).
  • Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
  • Self-aware, with the confidence to work independently.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

Account for branch’s operations; counter transactions including system operations to ensure execution accuracy, compliance, and completeness in line with bank internal and external rules/procedures/manuals/standards/group requirements/regulatory requirement/laws as well as to keep high class level of services to our clients

职责范围：

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities/Challenges 主要工作职责/挑战

General 总则

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Business Performance 业务表现

  • Support to achieve business objective at the respective branch
  • Drive or support cost optimization initiatives to achieve cost saving target
  • 协助分支行实现工作目标
  • 主动倡议或协助银行推进各项成本优化创新方案的实现

Service 客户服务质量

  • Embed client centric mind in daily operation as well as to maintain up best in class front-line service
  • Continue to advocate human banker and client centric service mindset in service staff for enriching internal and external customer experience
  • Achieve client satisfaction in daily branch services and operations
  • Build SCB a great place to work
  • 在日常工作中始终倡导“以客户为中心”的服务理念，给客户提供最优质的服务
  • 在服务中始终秉承“以人为本，以客户为中心”的服务理念，保持并提升内外部客户的服务体验
  • 在分支行日常对外服务中，始终以客户满意为服务宗旨
  • 始终立志于共同将渣打银行构建成一个员工和客户都喜欢的公司

Operations, Conduct and Risk Control 营运操作，行为规范和风险控制

  • Handle all counter operations, branch transactions in good result to ensure all bank internal and external rules/standards/procedures/manual are strictly followed
  • Perform bank required due diligence in branch start of day and end of day work on daily base to ensure no exception in execution
  • Complete regulatory required reporting timely and accurately to ensure the report follows regulatory requirements with no exception
  • Support Line Manager achieve good MCA rating in branch audit
  • Escalate for any exception detected or observed in daily work to minimize potential negative impact on the bank

Programme description

The Greater Bay Area (“GBA”) Youth Employment Scheme is a programme organised by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for Hong Kong residents aged 29 or below with educational attainments awarded by higher education institutions (within or outside of Hong Kong) at sub-degree level or above and who are legally employable in Hong Kong and the Mainland. It aims to foster career development of young people, the exchange of talent in the GBA, and the opportunity to develop and grow a professional network.

As a participating organisation, we are offering roles within our key business areas across Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Foshan. Roles will be available in HK businesses: Retail Banking & Wealth, Commercial Banking.


Who you are

We’re looking for people who love building connections, supporting others, and making a real impact. You don’t need to know everything about banking – bring your curiosity and drive, and we’ll help with the rest.


You could be a great fit if you’re:

  • A natural collaborator who enjoys working closely with people to solve problems and deliver solutions.
  • A people person who enjoys building relationships and developing your own authentic style.
  • A self-starter: You spot challenges before they become problems and take ownership to fix them.
  • Positive under pressure: You stay calm when it counts and bring energy and optimism to the table.
  • A clear communicator who can simplify complex information in writing and conversation.
  • Eager to learn, ask questions, expand your knowledge and grow your skillset.


What you’ll do

Throughout your time at HSBC, you’ll be supported by experienced managers and a wide network of diverse colleagues in the region and around the world. You’ll take part in on-the-job training in both Hong Kong and the mainland Greater Bay Area for the duration of your placement.


Over the course of the placement, you’ll gain experience and insight into the business area you join. You’ll receive a combination of on-the-job practical experience, project-based work and functional exposure, and be encouraged to learn, ask questions, take on real responsibilities and develop your professional network.


What you’ll learn

Throughout the programme, you’ll strengthen core professional skills including:

Stakeholder management

Time management

Decision-making

Problem-solving

Communication and presentation skills


You’ll also build role-specific technical skills based on your business area, gaining real-world experience in operations, banking systems, regulatory knowledge, data handling, customer experience, financial products, or digital processes.


By the end of the programme, you’ll have a strong foundation to grow your career – with the opportunity to be considered for a full-time client-facing role at HSBC.

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Work in PCVC team to manage the Product control activities for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Support Team Head to establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

Skills and Experience

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness
  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
  • CICPA & CFA is preferred
  • Languages: Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.
